decisions.reason: Uses both host files to separate clipboard-projection draft/occurrence offsets from detect coordinates where a chip is one U+FFFC, and notes plain text is identical in both.

Locates draft.length in add, explains empty composer makes both coordinates coincide, then the span overshoots the short detect text so insertReference returns false and the plugin emits the misleading changed-composer toast; explicitly rejects a real race.

Traces remove passing clipboard offset/length unconverted to consumeToken, return ignored, records.delete unconditional, dock renders unavailable while composer chip survives; ties it to the same coordinate misread.

Derives subtract-(length-1)-per-preceding-chip rule from the contract, applies it at insert (all occurrences) and removal (preceding chips, one-character span), keeps draftRev guard, and deletes records only on successful consumption.

Covers two successive pastes with both chips present, removal bookkeeping, declined-consumption and interleaving, but the removal tests remove the first/only chip and never remove a chip that has another chip before it while asserting the other survives.
